title: B1 effective session policy and backend parity
featureClaim: read-only effective policy projection; no execution, config write or grant expansion

acceptance.criterion: Generate a read-only session policy from TF-0512 owner-resolved current facts with scope/generation, backend/binding, model/effort, grant and bounded limits.
Keep configured, effective, unverified, unsupported and ignored facts separate; missing/stale/mismatched receipts remain unknown.
Report Codex native compact and Claude ownsNativeCompaction compatibility without creating another capability inventory.
Exclude credentials/auth values/private prompts and keep reads side-effect-free.

unmeasured: live provider-backed native thread continuation after a real model call
remote Gateway generation rotation across a process partition

cleanup.notes: Deterministic builder and source readback only; no provider or runtime process was launched for B1 artifacts.

limitations: The policy reports current runtime facts; it does not create a capability inventory or claim every backend supports every parameter.
A missing or stale TF-0512 profile intentionally leaves effective facts unknown.
All evidence is agent-driven; no real-human evidence is claimed.
